role: archival parameter snapshot, not a CLI input file

parameters.source_policy: DNN source checkpoint and ID lists reused exactly from 8638; fresh matched MF; source batch512 kept for DNN comparability (author task3 uses256)
parameters.residual: fixed ordinary item mean + source-list interaction only; no learned item bias; zero final encoder layer; same original LIST encoder/dimensions
parameters.residual_training: fit unscaled correction at lambda1; validation chooses epoch0..10 and lambda; zero ties keep epoch0
parameters.selection: inner cold-user validation RMSE; all methods freshly refit full outer train for selected epochs; lambda frozen before refit
parameters.shuffle: fixed user derangement separately within original inner_train,validation,test groups; unchanged during full refit
parameters.baselines: ordinary item mean only; all models fallback to ordinary mean on unseen target items
parameters.pf_protocol: author MF and DNN forward, inversion300 and K70000; all target user rows including cold untrained rows vote; no LR/K search
parameters.evaluation: every new final model frozen before test labels; historical test reused; comparisons exploratory; no ten-run paper reproduction

split_parameters.split: sorted raw IDs; nested test sets from one random permutation; round(beta*N), same count rule as paper
split_parameters.cleanup: remove every cross-domain shared raw item from source only; target untouched; no renewed 5-core
